Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the deep dive last week — the team loved the latency benchmarks and the eval looked promising. We're approaching a decision point but have a couple constraints on our side that we hoped Redwood could help with to get across the line: 

- Trial extension: we need another 90 days to finish integration and internal security signoff (current trial ends mid-July).
- Credits: a one-time $40,000 credit to cover evaluation usage and early production spikes while we onboard.
- Commercial concession: a 20% discount on list for the first 12 months if we commit to a 12-month minimum usage tier (we're prepared to commit to a baseline monthly spend if these concessions are available).

I know this is a big ask but this package materially reduces our procurement risk and will let us sign within Q3. Can you escalate to leadership for an exception? Happy to provide more usage projections — attaching our high-level staging plan and projected RPCs.

Appreciate it,
Sara

Jonas — thanks for the summary and the attachments. I reviewed the usage projection and the deal metrics. Recommendation for a fast close (Q3) while protecting unit economics:

- Approve a conditional one-time credit of $30,000 (applied to the first invoice).
- Approve a 20% discount on list for the first 3 months only, contingent on a signed 12-month MOP (Minimum Order Period) and a usage cap of 1.5x projected monthly consumption during those first 3 months.
- Require Legal to add a clause that unused credits expire at the end of the trial extension and that credits cannot be rolled to future years.

This reduces our upfront exposure and gives the customer a clear ramp window. If TerraNova demonstrates >1.5x usage we’ll revisit with a committed overage plan. Marcus — can you confirm finance is comfortable with credits applied as invoice credits and outline any billing steps?

If Marcus and Aditya approve, Jonas please send the conditional offer to Sara (we should phrase it as a conditional promotional package subject to MOP and cap).

-Marissa
VP Sales, Redwood Inference

Thanks team — I reviewed the recommendation. Approve the conditional concession with the following tweak to protect margin:

- One-time credit: $30,000 (invoice credit).
- Discount: 18% off list for months 1–3 only (rather than 20%).
- Usage cap: 1.5x projected monthly consumption for first 3 months; any overage billed at list and outside credits.
- Legal/Finance: add explicit credit expiry and invoicing instructions; credit applied to first invoice after conversion.

Jonas: you have exec signoff to present this as our approved exception package. Emphasize the conditional nature and that final execution will include MOP and credit expiry terms.

Aditya Rao
